My dear [Miss Smith](../persons.html#263)
I with I could have made room for this very amusing account while it is fresh, but my October [number](../others.html#52) is full, and I must give it up

yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: Envelope addressed to Miss Carter Smith/ 9 College Green/ Worcester, stamp and postmark cut out, reverse postmarked Worcester 7 September 1882.

Endorsed in ink on front of letter ‘Enclosure to be burnt 21.11.9.’
